reading.workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260818-01 verified that Google ADK now always marks A2A-originated invocations, including requests whose peer metadata is empty or absent, and that the changed tool-confirmation processor returns before resolving confirmation events when that A2A marker is present; regression tests cover both metadata-present and no-metadata cases, blocking the demonstrated remote-peer self-approval path without proving complete HITL security. Q-20260818-02 verified a SQLite-backed durable queue wakeup architecture: PRAGMA data_version detects cross-connection change, durable per-thread revisions identify affected loaded queues and are backfilled/updated across insert, update and delete, newly loaded/resumed threads are reconciled separately, and per-thread 10-second retry tasks allow one blocked wake to retry without stalling unrelated queues; this is not distributed exactly-once execution. Q-20260818-03 verified an exec-server observability boundary in which the inbound request span and queue timestamp are created at connection-queue receipt, optional W3C parent context is validated, the same span survives server/client queues and route execution, queue latency is emitted only after admission with a bounded route label, and terminal operational outcomes including error/disconnect are recorded; this does not prove complete causal tracing or external-side-effect rollback. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
reading.workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260818-01 核验了 Google ADK 现在始终标记 A2A 来源的 Invocation，即使远端 Metadata 为空或缺失也保留 A2A Marker；变更后的工具确认处理器一旦检测到该 Marker，就会在解析确认事件之前直接返回。回归测试同时覆盖有 Metadata 与无 Metadata 两种情况，阻断已证明的远程对端自我审批路径，但不能扩大解释为完整 HITL 安全。Q-20260818-02 核验了基于 SQLite 的持久队列唤醒架构：PRAGMA data_version 用于发现跨连接变化，持久 Thread Revision 用于定位受影响的已加载队列，并在 Insert、Update、Delete 时更新且对旧队列迁移回填；新加载/恢复 Thread 另行 Reconcile；每个 Thread 拥有独立的固定 10 秒重试任务，使单个阻塞 Wake 不拖住无关队列。该机制不等于分布式 Exactly-once。Q-20260818-03 核验了 Exec-server 请求可观测边界：请求进入 Connection Queue 时即创建 Inbound Span 与排队时间戳，可选 W3C Parent Context 会先验证；同一 Span 贯穿 Server/Client Queue 与 Route Execution；Queue Latency 仅在 Admission 之后按有界 Route Label 记录；Error/Disconnect 等终态会被记录。该机制不能扩大解释为完整因果追踪或外部副作用回滚。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。

workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic verification of the authoritative Analysis prompt SHA-256, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-18 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260818-01 concludes that accountable human approval must be qualified by receiver-controlled origin provenance separately from user-role content; the demonstrated A2A rejection closes a remote-peer self-approval path but does not prove the positive human authentication and authorization chain. Q-20260818-02 concludes that persistence and reconciliation are separate durable-work responsibilities: preserved work still needs external-change detection, durable object-level change identity, lifecycle reconciliation and isolated retry ownership, without implying distributed exactly-once execution or consensus. Q-20260818-03 concludes that request lifecycle telemetry and external-effect certainty are separate evidence planes: a terminal span can establish the instrumented request outcome while an external side effect may remain unknown and require separate authoritative effect evidence or reconciliation. researchObjects.judgment: Human approval should be modeled as an accountable-origin authorization event rather than a property of user-role content; receiver-controlled provenance can fail-close remote-origin approval classes, while positive human authentication and authorization remain separate requirements.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 真人审批应被建模为可追责来源的授权事件，而不是 user-role 内容本身的属性；接收端控制的 Provenance 可以对远程来源审批类别进行 Fail-closed，但正向真人身份认证与授权仍是独立要求。

researchObjects.judgment: Durable agent work should separate persistence from reconciliation: preserved state needs a live mechanism for change detection, object-level change identity, lifecycle discovery and isolated retry ownership, and none of those mechanisms alone proves exactly-once execution or distributed exclusivity.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 持久 Agent Work 应把 Persistence 与 Reconciliation 分开：被保存的状态仍需要活跃机制承担变化检测、对象级变化身份、生命周期发现与隔离 Retry Ownership；这些机制本身都不能证明 Exactly-once Execution 或分布式排他执行。

researchObjects.judgment: Request lifecycle telemetry should reconstruct queue receipt through terminal transport outcome, but external-effect certainty requires a separate authoritative evidence plane; disconnect can be a terminal telemetry state while the external effect remains unknown.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Request Lifecycle Telemetry 应重建从 Queue Receipt 到 Terminal Transport Outcome 的路径，但 External-effect Certainty 需要独立权威 Evidence Plane；Disconnect 可以是 Telemetry 终态，而外部 Effect 仍然未知。
